AND ( (p.author_id = #{viewerId} AND p.lifecycle<>'DELETED') OR (p.lifecycle='PUBLISHED' AND ( p.audience='PUBLIC' OR (p.audience='FOLLOWERS' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_follow f WHERE f.member_id=#{viewerId} AND f.follow_member_id=p.author_id)) OR (p.audience='COMMUNITY' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM club_member cm WHERE cm.member_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.club_id=p.community_id AND cm.status=1 AND cm.del_flag=0)) )) ) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block b WHERE (b.member_id=#{viewerId} AND b.blocked_member_id=p.author_id) OR (b.member_id=p.author_id AND b.blocked_member_id=#{viewerId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute mu WHERE mu.member_id=#{viewerId} AND mu.muted_member_id=p.author_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post_member_action na WHERE na.post_id=p.id AND na.member_id=#{viewerId} AND na.action_type='NOT_INTERESTED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post_member_action sla JOIN community_post hidden_author_post ON hidden_author_post.id=sla.post_id WHERE sla.member_id=#{viewerId} AND sla.action_type='SEE_LESS_AUTHOR' AND hidden_author_post.author_id=p.author_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post_member_action slt JOIN community_post_topic selected_topic ON selected_topic.post_id=slt.post_id JOIN community_post_topic candidate_topic ON candidate_topic.post_id=p.id AND candidate_topic.topic_code=selected_topic.topic_code WHERE slt.member_id=#{viewerId} AND slt.action_type='SEE_LESS_TOPIC')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_search_document(document_type,document_id,owner_member_id,title,search_text,city_code, topic_codes_json,visibility_state,source_version,indexed_at) SELECT 'POST',p.id,p.author_id,p.title,CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title,''),' ',p.body),p.city_code, COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(t.topic_code) FROM community_post_topic t WHERE t.post_id=p.id),JSON_ARRAY()), #{visibilityState},p.version,#{now} FROM community_post p WHERE p.id=#{postId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_member_id=VALUES(owner_member_id),title=VALUES(title),search_text=VALUES(search_text), city_code=VALUES(city_code),topic_codes_json=VALUES(topic_codes_json),visibility_state=VALUES(visibility_state), source_version=VALUES(source_version),indexed_at=VALUES(indexed_at)

INSERT INTO community_member_governance_state(member_id,last_event_type,last_event_payload_json,last_event_at,version,create_time,update_time) VALUES(#{memberId},#{eventType},#{payloadJson},#{now},1,#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_event_type=VALUES(last_event_type), last_event_payload_json=VALUES(last_event_payload_json),last_event_at=VALUES(last_event_at), version=version+1,update_time=VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO community_notification(recipient_member_id,event_id,post_id,comment_id,actor_member_id,notification_type,aggregate_key,actor_count, payload_json,create_time,update_time) SELECT #{recipientMemberId},#{eventId},#{postId},#{commentId},#{actorMemberId},#{notificationType},#{aggregateKey},1,#{payloadJson},#{now},#{now} WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_notification_preference np WHERE np.member_id=#{recipientMemberId} AND ( (#{notificationType}='INTERACTION' AND np.interaction_enabled=0) OR (#{notificationType}='COMMENT_MENTION' AND np.mention_enabled=0) OR (#{notificationType}='SOCIAL' AND np.social_enabled=0) ) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id=VALUES(event_id),actor_member_id=VALUES(actor_member_id), payload_json=VALUES(payload_json),read_at=NULL,update_time=VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO community_notification_actor(recipient_member_id,notification_type,aggregate_key, actor_member_id,last_event_id,create_time,update_time) VALUES(#{recipientMemberId},#{notificationType},#{aggregateKey},#{actorMemberId},#{eventId},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_event_id=VALUES(last_event_id),update_time=VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post p WHERE p.id=#{postId} AND p.lifecycle IN ('PUBLISHED','LIMITED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block b WHERE (b.member_id=#{recipientMemberId} AND b.blocked_member_id=#{actorMemberId}) OR (b.member_id=#{actorMemberId} AND b.blocked_member_id=#{recipientMemberId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute m WHERE m.member_id=#{recipientMemberId} AND m.muted_member_id=#{actorMemberId}) AND (#{commentId} IS NULL OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_post_comment c WHERE c.id=#{commentId} AND c.post_id=p.id AND c.lifecycle='PUBLISHED' AND c.author_approval_state='VISIBLE'))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ums_member recipient WHERE recipient.id=#{recipientMemberId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ums_member actor WHERE actor.id=#{actorMemberId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block b WHERE (b.member_id=#{recipientMemberId} AND b.blocked_member_id=#{actorMemberId}) OR (b.member_id=#{actorMemberId} AND b.blocked_member_id=#{recipientMemberId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute m WHERE m.member_id=#{recipientMemberId} AND m.muted_member_id=#{actorMemberId})
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET lifecycle='DELETED',title=NULL,body='',location_precision='NONE',city_code=NULL, poi_name=NULL,approximate_geohash=NULL,disclosure_type='NONE',safety_labels_json=JSON_ARRAY(), recommendation_eligible=0,search_eligible=0,interaction_enabled=0, deleted_at=COALESCE(deleted_at,#{now}),update_time=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE author_id=#{memberId}

UPDATE community_post_enforcement SET target_member_id=CASE WHEN target_member_id=#{memberId} THEN 0 ELSE target_member_id END, evidence_snapshot_json='{"erased":true}',update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE target_member_id=#{memberId} OR post_id IN (SELECT id FROM community_post WHERE author_id=#{memberId}) OR id IN (SELECT enforcement_id FROM community_post_appeal WHERE appellant_member_id=#{memberId})

UPDATE community_post_outbox o LEFT JOIN community_post p ON o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_POST' AND p.id=o.aggregate_id SET o.payload_json=JSON_OBJECT('erased',TRUE), o.state=CASE WHEN (o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_MEMBER' AND o.aggregate_id=#{memberId}) OR (o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_NOTIFICATION' AND ( o.aggregate_id=#{memberId} OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.actorId'))=CAST(#{memberId} AS CHAR) )) THEN 'DONE' ELSE o.state END, o.processed_at=CASE WHEN (o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_MEMBER' AND o.aggregate_id=#{memberId}) OR (o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_NOTIFICATION' AND ( o.aggregate_id=#{memberId} OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.actorId'))=CAST(#{memberId} AS CHAR) )) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE o.processed_at END, o.last_error_code=NULL,o.update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, o.aggregate_id=CASE WHEN o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_MEMBER' AND o.aggregate_id=#{memberId} THEN 0 WHEN o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_NOTIFICATION' AND o.aggregate_id=#{memberId} THEN 0 ELSE o.aggregate_id END WHERE (o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_POST' AND p.author_id=#{memberId}) OR (o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_MEMBER' AND o.aggregate_id=#{memberId}) OR (o.aggregate_type='COMMUNITY_NOTIFICATION' AND ( o.aggregate_id=#{memberId} OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.actorId'))=CAST(#{memberId} AS CHAR) ))
UPDATE community_post SET author_id=0,client_request_id=CONCAT('erased-post-',id),update_time=#{now} WHERE author_id=#{memberId}
UPDATE community_post_comment SET replied_to_member_id=NULL,update_time=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE replied_to_member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_member_mute WHERE member_id=#{memberId} OR muted_member_id=#{memberId}

DELETE n FROM community_notification n WHERE n.recipient_member_id=#{memberId} OR (n.notification_type!='SYSTEM_GOVERNANCE' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_notification_actor a WHERE a.recipient_member_id=n.recipient_member_id AND a.notification_type=n.notification_type AND a.aggregate_key=n.aggregate_key ))
DELETE FROM community_notification_actor WHERE recipient_member_id=#{memberId} OR actor_member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE community_notification n SET n.actor_member_id=( SELECT a.actor_member_id FROM community_notification_actor a WHERE a.recipient_member_id=n.recipient_member_id AND a.notification_type=n.notification_type AND a.aggregate_key=n.aggregate_key ORDER BY a.update_time DESC LIMIT 1 ), n.actor_count=( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_notification_actor c WHERE c.recipient_member_id=n.recipient_member_id AND c.notification_type=n.notification_type AND c.aggregate_key=n.aggregate_key ), n.payload_json=JSON_SET(n.payload_json,'$.actorId',COALESCE(( SELECT p.actor_member_id FROM community_notification_actor p WHERE p.recipient_member_id=n.recipient_member_id AND p.notification_type=n.notification_type AND p.aggregate_key=n.aggregate_key ORDER BY p.update_time DESC LIMIT 1 ),0)),n.update_time=#{now} WHERE n.notification_type!='SYSTEM_GOVERNANCE' AND n.actor_member_id=#{memberId}

mapper.select: SELECT id,post_id,author_id,root_id,parent_id,replied_to_member_id,client_request_id,body,lifecycle, author_approval_state,version,create_time FROM community_post_comment WHERE author_id=#{authorId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id,c.post_id,c.author_id,c.root_id,c.parent_id,c.lifecycle,c.author_approval_state FROM community_post_comment c JOIN community_post p ON p.id=c.post_id WHERE c.id=#{commentId} AND c.post_id=#{postId} AND c.lifecycle='PUBLISHED' AND c.author_approval_state='VISIBLE' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block cb WHERE (cb.member_id=#{viewerId} AND cb.blocked_member_id=c.author_id) OR (cb.member_id=c.author_id AND cb.blocked_member_id=#{viewerId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute cmu WHERE cmu.member_id=#{viewerId} AND cmu.muted_member_id=c.author_id)
SELECT id,post_id,author_id,root_id,parent_id,replied_to_member_id,body,lifecycle,author_approval_state,version FROM community_post_comment WHERE id=#{commentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post_comment SET lifecycle=#{targetLifecycle}, published_at=CASE WHEN #{targetLifecycle}='PUBLISHED' THEN COALESCE(published_at,#{now}) ELSE published_at END, update_time=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{commentId} AND lifecycle=#{expectedLifecycle} AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE community_post_comment c SET author_approval_state='VISIBLE',update_time=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE c.id=#{commentId} AND c.post_id=#{postId} AND c.lifecycle='PUBLISHED' AND c.author_approval_state='PENDING' AND c.version=#{expectedVersion} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post p WHERE p.id=#{postId} AND p.author_id=#{postAuthorId})

UPDATE community_post_comment c SET lifecycle='DELETED',deleted_at=#{now},update_time=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE c.id=#{commentId} AND c.post_id=#{postId} AND c.lifecycle!='DELETED' AND c.version=#{expectedVersion} AND (c.author_id=#{operatorMemberId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_post p WHERE p.id=#{postId} AND p.author_id=#{operatorMemberId}))
UPDATE community_post SET share_count=share_count+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{postId} AND lifecycle='PUBLISHED'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO community_post_comment_action(comment_id,member_id,action_type,request_id,create_time) SELECT c.id,#{memberId},'LIKE',#{requestId},#{now} FROM community_post_comment c JOIN community_post p ON p.id=c.post_id WHERE c.id=#{commentId} AND c.lifecycle='PUBLISHED' AND c.author_approval_state='VISIBLE' AND p.interaction_enabled=1
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block cb WHERE (cb.member_id=#{memberId} AND cb.blocked_member_id=c.author_id) OR (cb.member_id=c.author_id AND cb.blocked_member_id=#{memberId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute cmu WHERE cmu.member_id=#{memberId} AND cmu.muted_member_id=c.author_id)
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id,member_id,action_type FROM community_post_comment_action WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT comment_id,member_id,action_type,request_id FROM community_post_comment_action WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND action_type='LIKE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,member_id,request_id,command_type,aggregate_id,result_json,create_time FROM community_post_command_receipt WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_post_comment_action WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND action_type='LIKE'
mapper.select: WITH root_page AS ( SELECT r.id FROM community_post_comment r WHERE r.post_id=#{postId} AND r.parent_id IS NULL AND (r.lifecycle='PUBLISHED' OR (r.lifecycle='CHECKING' AND r.author_id=#{viewerId}) OR (r.lifecycle='DELETED' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_post_comment d WHERE d.post_id=#{postId} AND d.root_id=r.id AND (d.lifecycle='PUBLISHED' OR (d.lifecycle='CHECKING' AND d.author_id=#{viewerId})) AND (d.author_approval_state='VISIBLE' OR d.author_id=#{viewerId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_post pd WHERE pd.id=#{postId} AND pd.author_id=#{viewerId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block bd WHERE (bd.member_id=#{viewerId} AND bd.blocked_member_id=d.author_id) OR (bd.member_id=d.author_id AND bd.blocked_member_id=#{viewerId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute md WHERE md.member_id=#{viewerId} AND md.muted_member_id=d.author_id)))) AND (r.author_approval_state='VISIBLE' OR r.author_id=#{viewerId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_post p0 WHERE p0.id=#{postId} AND p0.author_id=#{viewerId})) AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR r.id<#{cursor}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block b0 WHERE (b0.member_id=#{viewerId} AND b0.blocked_member_id=r.author_id) OR (b0.member_id=r.author_id AND b0.blocked_member_id=#{viewerId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute mu0 WHERE mu0.member_id=#{viewerId} AND mu0.muted_member_id=r.author_id) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) SELECT c.id,c.post_id,c.author_id,c.root_id,c.parent_id,c.replied_to_member_id, CASE WHEN c.lifecycle='DELETED' THEN '' ELSE c.body END body,c.lifecycle, c.author_approval_state,c.version,c.like_count,c.create_time, m.nickname author_nickname,m.avatar author_avatar, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post_comment_action ca WHERE ca.comment_id=c.id AND ca.member_id=#{viewerId} AND ca.action_type='LIKE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END viewer_liked, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ums_member_follow cf WHERE cf.member_id=#{viewerId} AND cf.follow_member_id=c.author_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END viewer_following FROM root_page rp JOIN community_post_comment c ON c.post_id=#{postId} AND (c.id=rp.id OR c.root_id=rp.id) LEFT JOIN ums_member m ON m.id=c.author_id WHERE (c.lifecycle IN ('PUBLISHED','DELETED') OR (c.lifecycle='CHECKING' AND c.author_id=#{viewerId})) AND (c.author_approval_state='VISIBLE' OR c.author_id=#{viewerId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_post p2 WHERE p2.id=#{postId} AND p2.author_id=#{viewerId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block b WHERE (b.member_id=#{viewerId} AND b.blocked_member_id=c.author_id) OR (b.member_id=c.author_id AND b.blocked_member_id=#{viewerId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute mu WHERE mu.member_id=#{viewerId} AND mu.muted_member_id=c.author_id) ORDER BY rp.id DESC,CASE WHEN c.id=rp.id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,c.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post_enforcement SET report_case_id=#{reportCaseId},comment_id=#{commentId} WHERE id=#{id} AND report_case_id IS NULL AND comment_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM community_post_enforcement WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM community_post_enforcement WHERE operator_user_id=#{operatorUserId} AND request_id=#{requestId}

SELECT e.id,e.post_id,e.target_member_id,e.enforcement_type,e.rule_code,e.guideline_version_id,e.reason_code, e.previous_lifecycle,e.evidence_snapshot_json,e.operator_user_id,e.starts_at,e.ends_at,e.status,e.version, e.create_time,g.content_json guideline_content_json FROM community_post_enforcement e JOIN community_guideline_version g ON g.id=e.guideline_version_id WHERE e.post_id=#{postId} ORDER BY e.id DESC

SELECT e.id,e.post_id,e.target_member_id,e.enforcement_type,e.rule_code,e.guideline_version_id, e.reason_code,e.previous_lifecycle,e.starts_at,e.ends_at,e.status,e.version,e.create_time, a.id appeal_id,a.status appeal_status,a.decision_reason,a.reviewed_at FROM community_post_enforcement e LEFT JOIN community_post p ON p.id=e.post_id LEFT JOIN community_post_appeal a ON a.enforcement_id=e.id AND a.appellant_member_id=#{memberId} WHERE (e.target_member_id=#{memberId} OR (e.target_member_id IS NULL AND p.author_id=#{memberId})) AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR e.id<#{cursor}) ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM community_post_appeal WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT a.id,a.enforcement_id,a.appellant_member_id,a.reason,a.evidence_asset_ids_json,a.status, a.reviewer_user_id,a.reviewed_at,a.decision_reason,a.version,a.create_time,e.post_id,e.enforcement_type, e.rule_code,e.reason_code,e.evidence_snapshot_json,e.guideline_version_id, g.content_json guideline_content_json FROM community_post_appeal a JOIN community_post_enforcement e ON e.id=a.enforcement_id JOIN community_guideline_version g ON g.id=e.guideline_version_id WHERE (#{status} IS NULL OR a.status=#{status}) AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR a.id<#{cursor}) ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post_enforcement SET status='REVERSED',update_time=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT previous_lifecycle FROM community_post_enforcement WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND enforcement_type IN ('HIDE_PENDING_REVIEW','REMOVE') AND status='ACTIVE' AND starts_at<=#{now} AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at>#{now}) AND previous_lifecycle IS NOT NULL ORDER BY starts_at,id LIMIT 1

SELECT previous_lifecycle FROM community_post_enforcement WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND enforcement_type IN ('HIDE_PENDING_REVIEW','REMOVE') AND status IN ('EXPIRED','REVERSED') AND previous_lifecycle IS NOT NULL ORDER BY update_time DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT post_id FROM community_post_enforcement WHERE post_id IS NOT NULL AND status='ACTIVE' AND ((starts_at<=#{now} AND update_time<starts_at) OR (ends_at IS NOT NULL AND ends_at<=#{now})) ORDER BY post_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post_enforcement SET status='EXPIRED',update_time=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND ends_at IS NOT NULL AND ends_at<=#{now}

UPDATE community_post SET lifecycle=#{lifecycle},recommendation_eligible=#{recommendationEligible}, search_eligible=#{searchEligible},interaction_enabled=#{interactionEnabled}, published_at=CASE WHEN #{lifecycle}='PUBLISHED' THEN COALESCE(published_at,#{now}) ELSE published_at END, update_time=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{postId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND lifecycle!='DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT n.id,n.post_id,n.comment_id, CASE WHEN n.notification_type='SYSTEM_GOVERNANCE' THEN n.actor_member_id ELSE ( SELECT na.actor_member_id FROM community_notification_actor na WHERE na.recipient_member_id=n.recipient_member_id AND na.notification_type=n.notification_type AND na.aggregate_key=n.aggregate_key AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block ab WHERE (ab.member_id=#{memberId} AND ab.blocked_member_id=na.actor_member_id) OR (ab.member_id=na.actor_member_id AND ab.blocked_member_id=#{memberId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute am WHERE am.member_id=#{memberId} AND am.muted_member_id=na.actor_member_id) ORDER BY na.update_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) END actor_member_id, n.notification_type, CASE WHEN n.notification_type='SYSTEM_GOVERNANCE' THEN n.actor_count ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_notification_actor nc WHERE nc.recipient_member_id=n.recipient_member_id AND nc.notification_type=n.notification_type AND nc.aggregate_key=n.aggregate_key AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block cb WHERE (cb.member_id=#{memberId} AND cb.blocked_member_id=nc.actor_member_id) OR (cb.member_id=nc.actor_member_id AND cb.blocked_member_id=#{memberId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute cm WHERE cm.member_id=#{memberId} AND cm.muted_member_id=nc.actor_member_id) ) END actor_count, n.payload_json,n.read_at,n.create_time FROM community_notification n WHERE n.recipient_member_id=#{memberId} AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR n.id<#{cursor}) AND ( n.notification_type='SYSTEM_GOVERNANCE' OR ( ( (n.notification_type='SOCIAL' AND n.post_id IS NULL) OR ( n.post_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post p WHERE p.id=n.post_id) AND (n.comment_id IS NULL OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_post_comment nc WHERE nc.id=n.comment_id AND nc.post_id=n.post_id AND nc.lifecycle='PUBLISHED' AND nc.author_approval_state='VISIBLE')) ) ) AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_notification_actor nv WHERE nv.recipient_member_id=n.recipient_member_id AND nv.notification_type=n.notification_type AND nv.aggregate_key=n.aggregate_key AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_block nb WHERE (nb.member_id=#{memberId} AND nb.blocked_member_id=nv.actor_member_id) OR (nb.member_id=nv.actor_member_id AND nb.blocked_member_id=#{memberId})) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_member_mute nmu WHERE nmu.member_id=#{memberId} AND nmu.muted_member_id=nv.actor_member_id) ) ) ) ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT interaction_enabled,mention_enabled,social_enabled FROM community_notification_preference WHERE member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_notification_preference(member_id,interaction_enabled,mention_enabled,social_enabled,create_time,update_time) VALUES(#{memberId},COALESCE(#{interactionEnabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},1),COALESCE(#{mentionEnabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},1), COALESCE(#{socialEnabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},1),#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE interaction_enabled=COALESCE(#{interactionEnabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},interaction_enabled), mention_enabled=COALESCE(#{mentionEnabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},mention_enabled), social_enabled=COALESCE(#{socialEnabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},social_enabled),update_time=VALUES(update_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE community_notification SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,#{now}),update_time=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND recipient_member_id=#{memberId}
